data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2022 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding balance was $724.298m. During 2022 the syndicate recorded a net release of prior year claims reserves of $7.883m (a c.1.09% release of opening gross claims outstanding), driven by favourable incurred claims development across several classes (notably Property D&F, Marine Hull, Marine Energy, Non-Marine Liability and Political Risk). No gross prior-year movement figure was disclosed; the quantified release cited in the accounts is a net (after reinsurance) amount. The syndicate also made targeted IBNR allowances for exposures related to the Russia/Ukraine conflict and was affected in 2022 by Hurricane Ian.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $193,957,000 (2021: $196,366,000) is a release of $7,883,000 in claims reserves established for losses incurred at the prior year end (2021: release $7,832,000).

The calendar year result also benefitted from favourable incurred claims development on prior accident years from a number of classes, including Property D&F, Marine Hull, Marine Energy, Non-Marine Liability and Political Risk.
We have made specific incurred but not reported ("IBNR") allowances for classes where there is potential for losses arising as a result of the ongoing Russia/Ukraine conflict.
Inflation, in all its forms including social inflation, continues to be a key theme of discussion and has been specifically factored into our reserving this year.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement (gross change to 'insurance liabilities') is not explicitly disclosed in the notes. The accounts explicitly state a net prior-year release of $7.883m (used above) but no gross prior-year movement figure is given. A gross claims development triangle (gross incurred claims by underwriting year) is present and shows the cumulative incurred estimates; it does not present a clear aggregated gross PYD figure separate from current-year movements. Therefore the reported prior_year_development_gbp_m is the NET release (explicitly stated) and has been flagged as net in this note. All monetary amounts are reported in the syndicate's presentation currency (USD).
